title: Microplate readers at a glance: 21 practical questions
summary: A question-led overview of nine microplate readers, with the conditions behind each answer and links to the detailed comparison.
body_html:
Start with the capabilities that matter to your assay. The answers below retain the conditions that distinguish a standard feature from an option, a partial capability or an unconfirmed specification. Follow each question to the detailed finding.

Read the detailed comparison →
